methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper presents a new analysis method of the evolution of energy efficiency and the assessment of energy savings / losses resulting from the evolution of energy efficiency for industrial End-Users and a presentation of a new energy performance indicator - energy effectiveness - which allows qualitative analysis of energy utilization in the case of industrial end-users, by dividing energy consumption into productive consumption and non-productive consumption.

paper_type.evidence_quote: It is presented the application of the new energy analysis method in case of an industrial End-User with an energy consumption of over 1000 TEP/year, having as a profile the casting of non-ferrous metals.

multi_site.evidence_quote: Energy analysis is carried both for electricity and natural gas consumptions, at the level of the entire organization.
